title: ABEAR Code of Conduct Violations — LATAM Brazil's Systematic Breach of Industry Self‑Regulation Standards on Ethics, Transparency, and Consumer Protection

confidence.note: LATAM’s conduct across both incidents systematically violates ABEAR’s ethical, transparency, and integrity standards. The structural conflict of interest with Juliano Noman now heading ABEAR is noted. Case update cross‑references BR‑014 and BR‑018.

incident_timestamp_display: 4 April 2024 (GRU) and 5 July 2024 (SCL) — ABEAR violations span both incidents
allegation_summary: LATAM Airlines Brazil, a member of ABEAR (Associação Brasileira das Empresas Aéreas), systematically violated ABEAR’s Code of Conduct, which requires the highest standards of ethics, transparency, and integrity. Specific violations include: (1) Ethics — employee André BD Marinho committed criminal injúria and ameaça against a consumer (I‑001); (2) Transparency — LATAM maintained false accusations of aggression despite PDI exoneration, withheld CCTV evidence, and refused to provide written documentation of the lifetime ban (I‑002); (3) Integrity — LATAM engaged in KPI manipulation, case fragmentation, and gaslighting communications (both incidents). The former ANAC President, Juliano Noman, now serves as ABEAR President, creating a structural conflict where the industry self‑regulation body is led by the former head of the regulator that improperly dismissed the complaint. This situation exacerbates the code of conduct violations by undermining ABEAR’s capacity to objectively enforce its standards against LATAM.
evidentiary_strength: HIGH. The conduct across both incidents is well‑documented. The ABEAR Code of Conduct is a publicly available standard. Cross‑referenced with BR‑014 and BR‑018.
legal_theory: Violação reiterada do código de autorregulação setorial, configurando prática comercial abusiva (CDC Art. 39) e quebra da confiança do consumidor, agravada pelo conflito estrutural de interesses na direção da ABEAR.

full_segments.speaker: Latam Supervisora (Antonela)
full_segments.verbatim_es: ¿Aquí está su carta, don Leandro?
full_segments.translation_en: Here is your letter, Mr. Leandro?

full_segments.speaker: Leandro Disconzi (passenger)
full_segments.verbatim_es: hay mi carta? Déjame ver.
full_segments.translation_en: Is there my letter? Let me see.

full_segments.speaker: Leandro Disconzi (passenger)
full_segments.verbatim_es: la latam declara que el dia el vuelo operado a asaya ocurrio un desvio a lo planificado, el motivo de lo ir fue denegacion de embarque.
full_segments.translation_en: LATAM declares that on the day the flight operated to Asaya there was a deviation from the planned, the reason for the going was denial of boarding.

full_segments.speaker: Leandro Disconzi (passenger)
full_segments.verbatim_es: se nega embarque por la siguiente razón, agresiona al personal de la latam, ingresa la aeronave sin autorización, no respeta la instrucción. ¿tú sabes que eso fue comprobado por la pdi, que eso no pasó?
full_segments.translation_en: boarding is denied for the following reason: you assaulted LATAM personnel, entered the aircraft without authorization, did not respect the instruction. Do you know that this was verified by the PDI, that this did not happen?

full_segments.speaker: Latam Supervisora (Antonela)
full_segments.verbatim_es: esta es la carta que usted pidió. Señor, esa es la información que nosotros tenemos de lo sucedido. No podemos cambiar la información que tenemos. Señor, esa es la información que...
full_segments.translation_en: This is the letter you requested. Sir, that is the information we have about what happened. We cannot change the information we have. Sir, that is the information that...

full_segments.speaker: Leandro Disconzi (passenger)
full_segments.verbatim_es: Yo estoy preguntando si tiene pruebas para eso.
full_segments.translation_en: I am asking if you have proof for that.

full_segments.speaker: Leandro Disconzi (passenger)
full_segments.verbatim_es: La carta yo pedí lo que pasó. Estas son las acusaciones que fueron desprobadas..
full_segments.translation_en: The letter I asked for what happened. These are the accusations that were disproven.

full_segments.speaker: Latam Supervisora (Antonela)
full_segments.verbatim_es: No me grite porque yo no lo estoy viendo. Yo no estoy gritando. Le voy a pedir que no lo haga.
full_segments.translation_en: Don't yell at me because I am not looking at you. I am not yelling. I am going to ask you not to do it.

full_segments.speaker: Leandro Disconzi (passenger)
full_segments.verbatim_es: y la entrada, ingresar a la aeronave sin autorización, si ustedes tienen alguna prueba para eso? Ah, entonces, ¿quién llegó a esa conclusión entonces?
full_segments.translation_en: And the entry, entering the aircraft without authorization, do you have any proof of that? Ah, then, who reached that conclusion then?

full_segments.speaker: Latam Supervisora (Antonela)
full_segments.verbatim_es: Eso lo vamos a ver en el área legal. Ellos tienen en este momento las imágenes y las demandas de salida.
full_segments.translation_en: That we will see in the legal department. They have at this moment the images and the exit demands.

full_segments.speaker: Latam Supervisora (Antonela)
full_segments.verbatim_es: Eso lo tiene que ver después con el área legal cuando lo contacten. Eso no lo vemos nosotros, lo ve el área legal.
full_segments.translation_en: That you have to see later with the legal department when they contact you. That we do not see, the legal department sees it.

full_segments.speaker: Leandro Disconzi (passenger)
full_segments.verbatim_es: yo como pasajero, como cliente, me quedo botado sin mi pasaje, prohibido de volar a la latam.
full_segments.translation_en: I as a passenger, as a customer, I am left stranded without my ticket, banned from flying with LATAM.

full_segments.speaker: Latam Supervisora (Antonela)
full_segments.verbatim_es: Segundo la informacion que tenemos nosotros no le podemos dar otra opción.
full_segments.translation_en: According to the information we have, we cannot give you another option.

full_segments.speaker: Leandro Disconzi (passenger)
full_segments.verbatim_es: buenas noches. Muchas gracias.
full_segments.translation_en: Good night. Thank you very much.

full_segments.speaker: Leandro Disconzi (passenger)
full_segments.verbatim_es: entonces me fue enviado una carta explicándome lo que pasó, pero no hay una asignatura ni un timbre de latam.
full_segments.translation_en: So I was sent a letter explaining what happened, but there is no signature or a LATAM stamp.

full_segments.speaker: Leandro Disconzi (passenger)
full_segments.verbatim_es: creo que queda un poco complejo esto.
full_segments.translation_en: I think this gets a bit complicated.

full_segments.speaker: Leandro Disconzi (passenger)
full_segments.verbatim_es: mira, están me pasando un documento sin firma.
full_segments.translation_en: Look, they are giving me a document without a signature.

full_segments.speaker: Leandro Disconzi (passenger)
full_segments.verbatim_es: ¡firma tú!
full_segments.translation_en: You sign!

full_segments.speaker: Leandro Disconzi (passenger)
full_segments.verbatim_es: ¿por qué tú no quieres firmar?
full_segments.translation_en: Why don't you want to sign?

full_segments.speaker: Leandro Disconzi (passenger)
full_segments.verbatim_es: puedo hacer una pregunta. ¿quién escribió la carta?
full_segments.translation_en: Can I ask a question. Who wrote the letter?

full_segments.speaker: Leandro Disconzi (passenger)
full_segments.verbatim_es: yo estoy haciendo una pregunta. Yo estoy haciendo una pregunta.
full_segments.translation_en: I am asking a question. I am asking a question.

full_segments.speaker: Leandro Disconzi (passenger)
full_segments.verbatim_es: Pero tú me pasó una carta sin firmar. Tú me pasaste una carta sin firmar.
full_segments.translation_en: But you gave me an unsigned letter. You gave me an unsigned letter.

full_segments.speaker: Leandro Disconzi (passenger)
full_segments.verbatim_es: tu nombre, antonella.
full_segments.translation_en: Your name, Antonella.

full_segments.speaker: Leandro Disconzi (passenger)
full_segments.verbatim_es: Antonella sara algo. Mira, me pasó un documento que estoy esperando a ocho más horas sin una firma.
full_segments.translation_en: Antonella something. Look, I received a document that I have been waiting for eight plus hours without a signature.

full_segments.speaker: Leandro Disconzi (passenger)
full_segments.verbatim_es: y yo estoy esperando a la firma.
full_segments.translation_en: And I am waiting for the signature.

full_segments.speaker: Leandro Disconzi (passenger)
full_segments.verbatim_es: ¿ya?
full_segments.translation_en: Ready yet?

full_segments.speaker: Leandro Disconzi (passenger)
full_segments.verbatim_es: un documento no necesita de una firma
full_segments.translation_en: a document does not need a signature

full_segments.speaker: Leandro Disconzi (passenger)
full_segments.verbatim_es: nadie responde.
full_segments.translation_en: nobody answers.

full_segments.speaker: Leandro Disconzi (passenger)
full_segments.verbatim_es: entiendo que es abuso de autoridad lo que están haciendo.
full_segments.translation_en: I understand that this is abuse of authority what you are doing.

full_segments.speaker: Leandro Disconzi (passenger)
full_segments.verbatim_es: ¿es un discaso!
full_segments.translation_en: It's a disregard!
